import urllib.request, urllib.error, concurrent.futures
base = "http://222.20.126.52:32969"
words = """admin api app apps auth backup blog bootstrap cas cgi-bin cms config console content core dashboard data db debug default demo dev doc docs download downloads error errors files home host-manager html http image images img info jars java js jsp jsps lang lib libs list log login logout logs main manager media META-INF misc music news old page pages panel portal private public react REST root server servlet servlets sites site static status store system tag tags temp test tests tmp tomcat tools uploads users utils view views web WEB-INF webapps www vuln hackit ctf flag solr jmx hudson jenkins weblogic spring druid actuator heapdump prometheus grafana kibana elasticsearch seeyon ofbiz thinkphp discuz wordpress wp-admin joomla phpmyadmin hello world start example examples sample tutorial getting-started welcome index.html index.do index.action index.jsp ver.action ver.do ver welcome.html welcome.jsp""".split()
def check(w):
    for pre in ['/', '/']:
        url = base + pre + w
        try:
            r = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5)
            code, size = r.status, len(r.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            code, size = e.code, len(e.read())
        except Exception as e:

        if (code, size) != (404, 431) and code != 0:

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=20) as ex:
